summary_md: **Riclumen ([@ricardoscjy](https://x.com/ricardoscjy/status/2116718806639026661))** open-sourced **inkforge**, a skill for writing paid Chinese short web fiction using separate reviewing, writing and ideation threads, based on submission requirements from a contracted editor; the repo includes six models' raw outputs on the same prompt ([RicLumen/inkforge](https://github.com/RicLumen/inkforge)).
